title: Book a time
summary: The customer books with a business: service, then person (or Qualquer pessoa), then a day on a week strip and a free time, then a confirm step with the business policy. The time is held for 5 minutes until confirm (docs/scheduling.md, customer flow).

priceText.description: The price as the business wrote it, bipe_catalog_price_from for from, bipe_catalog_price_on_request for on request.

name.description: Person or station name; bipe_agenda_anyone for any.

date.description: Local date in the business time zone.

business.description: Handle or Matrix ID of the business.

agendas.description: From GET /v1/businesses/{business}/agenda/agendas?service_id. With one agenda the person step is skipped.

of.description: One choice. Qualquer pessoa first when there are two or more.

week.description: Seven days from GET /v1/businesses/{business}/agenda/slots, one call per week. A day with no slot is greyed out.

hold.description: The held booking from POST hold, with hold_expires_at.

moving.description: Booking ID when the flow reschedules an existing booking (Remarcar). The review step then calls move instead of hold and confirm.

error.description: The last error, shown as text.

pickService.effect: Sets selectedService, loads the agendas, and goes to person (or to time when there is one agenda).

pickAgenda.effect: Sets selectedAgenda and goes to time.

showWeek.effect: Loads the seven days that start at the date. Back is not allowed before today.

pickDay.effect: Sets selectedDate and shows its free times; bipe_agenda_no_slots when none.

pickTime.effect: POST /v1/businesses/{business}/agenda/hold with service, agenda and start. On success goes to review with the hold. On slot_taken shows bipe_agenda_error_slot_taken and reloads the week.

confirm.effect: POST .../bookings/{id}/confirm. On success closes the flow, shows bipe_agenda_booked and the card appears in the chat. On hold_expired shows bipe_agenda_error_hold_expired and goes back to time. When moving, POST .../bookings/{id}/move with agenda and start instead.

back.effect: Goes one step back. Leaving review keeps nothing: an unconfirmed hold ends by itself after 5 minutes.

notes: Booking needs a Bipe account (ADR 0100): the flow runs only signed in.
Times show in the phone's time zone; the week strip and the day groups use the business time zone (SlotDays.time_zone), so a day matches the business's day.
The price is text for the customer. Bipe takes no payment (ADR 0012, ADR 0099).
The person and the price never come from the customer: the server derives the customer from the token.
Free text (the dog's name, an allergy) goes in the chat, never in the booking (ADR 0102).
